agent_display_name: Антон - Agent Host Artifact Contract Canary
goal: After the Agent Host non-empty artifact contract PR is merged and deliberately deployed, run a Home canary that proves empty required artifacts block completion and non-empty canonical run artifacts are manifest-visible.
objective: Prepare and run a post-deploy canary only after the runtime Agent Host has been patched by a separate deploy task. Do not restart services from this canary. Submit a controlled task with an intentionally empty required artifact and confirm the result reports required_artifacts_empty and blocks completion, then submit a non-empty canonical artifact task and confirm PLAN.md, ACTIONS.md, TESTS.md, RESULT.md, and NEXT.md are mirrored into artifact_dir and listed in artifact-manifest.json.

requires_prior_steps: Merge the non-empty artifact contract PR.
Run a separate, owner-approved deploy task that patches the live Home Agent Host runtime.
Verify the patched Agent Host process is the active runtime before this canary starts.

canary_steps: Confirm this canary is running after merge and after a separate deploy task activated the patched Agent Host.
Submit a controlled task whose required_artifacts contains an intentionally empty PLAN.md.
Confirm the task blocks and reports required_artifacts_empty with the exact PLAN.md relative path.
Submit a controlled task that writes non-empty PLAN.md, ACTIONS.md, TESTS.md, RESULT.md, and NEXT.md under its canonical run directory.
Confirm result.json reports no required_artifacts_missing and no required_artifacts_empty.
Confirm artifact-manifest.json includes the nested canonical files and flat PLAN.md, ACTIONS.md, TESTS.md, RESULT.md, and NEXT.md copies.
Record canary evidence without restarting Agent Host or deploying code.
acceptance: The empty required artifact canary blocks completion.
The blocked result includes required_artifacts_empty and does not classify the empty file as present.
The non-empty canonical artifact canary completes its artifact contract.
The artifact manifest lists mirrored nested and flat canonical files.
No service restart, deploy, provider lifecycle operation, main push, force push, or secret exposure occurs in this canary.
